title: The Rescuers Down Under
blurb: Orville's high-strung younger brother, an albatross who reluctantly takes over air-taxi duties for the Rescue Aid Society in The Rescuers Down Under.
facts: It was directed by Hendel Butoy and Mike Gabriel and written by Jim Cox, Karey Kirkpatrick, Byron Simpson, and Joe Ranft.
Bob Newhart and Eva Gabor reprise their roles as Bernard and Bianca respectively, with John Candy, Tristan Rogers, Adam Ryen, Wayne Robson, and George C.
